R501.note: Array-form Runtime.exec closes the string-concat shell vector for both branches; added leading-dash rejection is disclosed and reasonable for a dir/ls path argument.

R502.note: Standard mysql2 parameterized query (? placeholder + values array); preserves callback signature and error handling exactly.

R503.note: Generic 500 message replaces leaked message/stack, status code preserved, existing logger.error(error) call retained for server-side visibility.

R504.note: Strict-comparison allowlist is the right mechanism, but only 'summary' is confirmed from the source - 'detail'/'compact' are guessed and could reject legitimate plugin names; write-up does flag this openly as needing adjustment.

R505.note: crypto.randomBytes/randomUUID are appropriate CSPRNG replacements; format/length change is inherent to the fix and not a hidden side effect.

R506.note: markupsafe.escape() neutralizes the reported <script> XSS payload but the sink render_template_string(page_html) still Jinja-parses the assembled string, so curly-brace payloads (e.g. q={{7*7}}) pass escape() untouched and are evaluated as SSTI by the same sink - wrong shape of fix for this sink; no other collateral behavior change.
